title: Computed finite-ring compact-support refinement, tower, composition and identity maps
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring in universe $u+1$. For schemes in universe $u$ use the bounded-below derived categories $D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,R)$ and $D^+_{\mathrm{proet}}(X,R)$ of ordinary module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $N_X$ be exact etale-to-pro-etale comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. For a compactification $c=(j_c,p_c)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] write $F_t^c=Rp_{c,*}^t j_{c,!}^t$, using [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and let $C_c:N_YF_{\mathrm{et}}^c\cong F_{\mathrm{proet}}^cN_X$ be the specified compact-support site comparison [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction]. Define the following actual maps, without asserting any coherence equation.

For a quasi-compact $f:X\to Y$ and compactifications $c,d$, let $m=c\wedge d$ be their canonical common proper refinement and $r_c:m\to c$, $r_d:m\to d$ its projections. Write $\rho_r(E):F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{\mathrm{coarse}}N_XE\cong F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{\mathrm{fine}}N_XE$ for the inverse of the refinement comparison in [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism]. Define $\Delta_{c,d}(E)=\rho_{r_d}(E)^{-1}\circ\rho_{r_c}(E)$ for every $E\in D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,R)$. Given also $K\in D^+_{\mathrm{proet}}(X,R)$ and a retained witness $w:N_XE\cong K$, define $\Delta_{c,d}(E,K,w)=F_{\mathrm{proet}}^d(w)\circ\Delta_{c,d}(E)\circ F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c(w^{-1})$.

For open immersions $j,k$ with an equality $j=k$, define the open-extension identification by equality transport of the derived open-extension functors. For a compatible compactification tower $T$ for $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower], write its compactifications as $T_f,T_g,T_{gf}$, its intermediate proper map as $p$, and its second open immersion as $q$, with $j_{T_f}q=j_{T_{gf}}$ and $pp_{T_g}=p_{T_{gf}}$. Define the open tower isomorphism $j_{T_f,!}j_{q,!}\cong j_{T_{gf},!}$ using the canonical derived-functor compositor, the existing open-extension composition [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], and the stated equality transport. Suppose $Y,Z$ are Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Define the tower arrow $A_T(E):F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{T_g}F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{T_f}N_XE\to F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{T_{gf}}N_XE$ by: inside $Rp_{T_g,*}$ first apply $j_{T_g,!}Rp_{T_f,*}$ to the inverse canonical open site comparison at $j_{T_f}$ [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-site-extension]; then apply the specified proper/open interchange $\Gamma^{\mathrm{proet}}$ [lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate] at $j_{T_f,!}^{\mathrm{et}}E$; then apply $Rp_*j_{q,!}$ to the forward open site comparison. Follow this by the canonical proper direct-image compositor [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image], its equality transport along $pp_{T_g}=p_{T_{gf}}$, and $Rp_{T_{gf},*}$ of the open tower isomorphism.

For quasi-compact $f,g$, supplied compactifications $c,d,e$ of $f,g,gf$, and such a tower $T$, define $\alpha_{c,d,e,T}(E)$ as the following paste, in order: $F_{\mathrm{proet}}^d(\Delta_{c,T_f}(E))$; $\Delta_{d,T_g}(F_{\mathrm{et}}^{T_f}E,F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{T_f}N_XE,C_{T_f}(E))$; $A_T(E)$; and $\Delta_{T_{gf},e}(E)$. For a retained witness $w:N_XE\cong K$, define $\alpha_{c,d,e,T}(E,K,w)=F_{\mathrm{proet}}^e(w)\circ\alpha_{c,d,e,T}(E)\circ F_{\mathrm{proet}}^dF_{\mathrm{proet}}^c(w^{-1})$. Finally define $F_{\mathrm{proet}}^{(1_X,1_X)}\cong\mathrm{id}$ by the ordinary direct-image identity, its right-derived comparison, the open-adjunction identity, and its exact-derived comparison. These definitions retain the origin witness and the supplied tower; choice independence, invertibility of the composition arrow, and site compatibility remain separate theorem assertions.

lean.statement:
def finiteCompactSiteCompositionAtWitness
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification g) (e : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    (T : Compactification.Triangle f g)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (E : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (w : (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj E ≅ K)
